span.p:
autoincrease_cooldown_minutes = 30
No further request raised for
region+CRG_type within cooldown window

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
If metric stays below threshold
throughout cooldown:
→ Alert: AutoIncreaseDebounceActive
Operator can intervene manually

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Evaluate DR CRG
for each managed region

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Evaluate Prod CRG
for each managed region

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Evaluate NonProd CRG
for each managed region

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
dr_crg_coverage_ratio
< policy.dr_autoincrease_threshold
(default: 0.35)
AND NOT in debounce window?

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
prod_crg_free_slots /
prod_crg_quantity
< policy.prod_autoincrease_threshold
(default: 0.20)
AND NOT in debounce window?

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
nonprod_crg_effective_free /
nprod_crg_quantity
< policy.nonprod_autoincrease_threshold
(default: 0.20)
AND NOT in debounce window?

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Compute target_qty
delta = ceil((dr_ratio_max - coverage_ratio)
× potential_dr_demand)
target = current_qty + delta

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Compute target_qty
delta = ceil(0.20 × prod_crg_qty)
target = current_qty + delta

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Compute target_qty
delta = ceil(0.20 × nprod_crg_qty)
target = current_qty + delta

(Severity: High)
Payload: region, crg_type, metric,
target_qty, quota_increase_needed_vcpu

Operator

status → REJECTED
Alert closed
No ARM ops

span.p:
PATCH CR quantity → target_qty
IF quota needed:
POST groupQuotas/{id}/quota
Poll until confirmed

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
RegionalSnapshot refreshed
status → COMPLETED
OperationRecord written

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Quota group headroom
sufficient for expansion?

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
PATCH CR quantity directly
Alert: CapacityAutoIncreaseExecuted
(Severity: Info)

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
POST groupQuotas/{id}/quota
Poll for Azure approval
Expand CR once confirmed
Alert: AutoIncreaseWithQuotaRequest
